en: The image shows a vintage postcard featuring the ruins of an old stone structure, likely a castle or fortress, set on a hillside with sparse vegetation. There is handwritten text along the borders and printed text at the bottom. The color tone is sepia or faded green, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The main printed text says 'Pozdrav iz Podsuseda', which translates to 'Greetings from Podsused'.
